_meta.indication: DUAVEE is indicated in women with a uterus for treatment of moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms associated with menopause and prevention of postmenopausal osteoporosis

pivotal_trials.trial_name: Study 305 (pivotal trial for the vasomotor symptoms indication)
pivotal_trials.population: Postmenopausal women with at least 7 moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms per day (or at least 50 per week)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Four standard co-primary endpoints evaluating change in frequency and severity of moderate to severe hot flushes from baseline
pivotal_trials.n: N=332 randomized (0.45 mg/20 mg n=133; placebo n=66)
pivotal_trials.result: At Week 12, placebo-subtracted treatment effect on hot flush frequency was -2.7 (-3.8, -1.6) and on severity -0.6 (-0.9, -0.4); p<0.001

pivotal_trials.trial_name: Study 303 (pivotal trial for the osteoporosis prevention indication)
pivotal_trials.design: 2-year, multicenter, double-blind trial randomizing to six CE/bazedoxifene daily doses, raloxifene 60 mg, or placebo; osteoporosis efficacy assessed in two substudies
pivotal_trials.population: Postmenopausal women with intact uteri; Substudy I >5 years postmenopausal with lumbar spine or total hip T-score -1 to -2.5 and at least one additional risk factor; Substudy II 1-5 years postmenopausal with at least one additional risk factor
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Mean percent change from baseline at Year 2 in lumbar spine bone mineral density (osteoporosis substudy primary endpoint)
pivotal_trials.n: Substudy I n=1454; Substudy II n=861
pivotal_trials.result: At 2 years, CE/BZA 0.45 mg/20 mg lumbar spine BMD mean difference vs placebo was 3.1% (2.3%, 3.9%) in Substudy I and 3.6% (2.6%, 4.6%) in Substudy II; all comparisons to placebo p<0.001

key_safety: Common adverse reactions (incidence ≥5%) were muscle spasms (9% vs 6% placebo), nausea (8% vs 5%), diarrhea (8% vs 5%), dyspepsia (7% vs 6%), abdominal pain upper (7% vs 5%), oropharyngeal pain (7% vs 6%), dizziness (5% vs 3%), and neck pain (5% vs 4%); serious risks include cardiovascular disorders (venous thromboembolism, stroke) and malignant neoplasms (endometrial, breast)
target_moa: Fixed-dose combination of conjugated estrogens (estrogen receptor agonists) paired with bazedoxifene, an estrogen agonist/antagonist that acts as an agonist in some estrogen-sensitive tissues (e.g., bone) and an antagonist in others (e.g., uterus); bazedoxifene reduces the risk of endometrial hyperplasia from the estrogen component
modality: Small molecule fixed-dose combination (conjugated estrogens plus bazedoxifene, an estrogen agonist/antagonist)

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: ENDOMETRIAL CANCER, CARDIOVASCULAR DISORDERS, AND PROBABLE DEMENTIA — increased risk of endometrial cancer with unopposed estrogens; estrogen therapy should not be used for prevention of cardiovascular disease or dementia; WHI estrogen-alone substudy reported increased risks of stroke and DVT; WHIMS reported increased risk of probable dementia in women 65 years and older

advisory_committee.vote: This NDA was not taken to advisory committee; no efficacy or safety issues were identified that needed panel input

basis.text: The application was reviewed under standard review

summary.text: Standard-review NDA for a fixed-dose combination of conjugated estrogens and bazedoxifene (a new molecular entity); approved first cycle for the 0.45 mg/20 mg dose for vasomotor symptoms and prevention of postmenopausal osteoporosis, with a complete response for the 0.625 mg/20 mg dose; no advisory committee was convened and one postmarketing CYP3A4 drug-interaction PK trial was required

citations.quote: Application Type NDAApplication Number(s) 22247Priority or Standard StandardSubmit Date(s) September 26, 2012Received Date(s) October 3, 2012PDUFA Goal Date October 3, 2013Division / Office DBRUP/ODE III/OND/CDER
Bazedoxifene, a new molecular entity, is an estrogen receptor agonist at some tissues (e.g., bone) and an estrogen receptor antagonist at others (e.g., uterus).
• Approval of the 0.45 mg/20 mg dose for the treatment of moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms associated with menopause and for the prevention of postmenopausal osteoporosis
This NDA was not taken to advisory committee. We did not identify efficacy or safety issues that needed input from an advisory panel.

requirement.text: PMR 2083-1: Phase 1 pharmacokinetic trial evaluating the effect of a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor and body weight on the exposure of conjugated estrogens and bazedoxifene

citations.quote: 2083-1 Pharmacokinetic trial evaluating the effect of a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor and body weight on the exposure of conjugated estrogens and bazedoxifene titled "A Phase 1, Open-Label, Two-Period, Fixed-Sequence Study to Estimate the Effects of Steady State Administration of a Strong CYP3A4 Inhibitor on the Single-Dose Pharmacokinetics of Conjugated Estrogens/Bazedoxifene in Non-obese (Body Mass Index <30 kg/m2) and Obese (Body Mass Index ≥ 30 kg/m2) Postmenopausal Women."
